ai.title: US stocks open higher as gains for AI-related stocks support the market
ai.description: A rebound for AI stocks is supporting Wall Street. The S&P 500 rose 0.4% in early trading Monday. The strength for companies in the artificial-intelligence technology industry sent the Nasdaq composite up 0.8%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 123 points, or 0.2%. Several major chip companies were posting gains. Micron Technology was up 2.5% and Broadcom climbed 3.7%. AI stocks have been swinging sharply in recent weeks on worries that their prices shot too high in the euphoria around AI. European indexes were lower, and Asia markets closed mixed overnight.
ai.title_cn: 人工智能相关股票上涨支撑市场，美股开盘走高
ai.description_cn: 人工智能股的反弹正在支撑华尔街。标准普尔500指数周一早盘上涨0.4%。人工智能技术行业公司的强劲推动纳斯达克综合指数上涨0.8%。道琼斯工业平均指数上涨123点，涨幅0.2%。几家主要芯片公司均出现上涨。美光科技上涨2.5%，博通上涨3.7%。人工智能股票最近几周一直在大幅波动，因为人们担心人工智能的兴奋情绪导致其价格飙升。欧洲指数走低，亚洲市场隔夜收盘涨跌互现。
